title: Emergency MEP Service Calls: Route Dispatch, Rate Approval, and Billable Work
summary: Coordinate emergency HVAC, electrical and plumbing callouts without losing authorization, rate and visit evidence.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


An emergency MEP service workflow should connect the request, dispatch decision, commercial authorization and performed work while keeping each state explicit. Capture who requested help, the affected site, the approved rate or spending limit, and the person responsible for resolving exceptions. Dispatch may need to act before every commercial detail is available, but the workflow should preserve that decision and route missing evidence promptly rather than treating urgency as blanket billing approval.


Explore the complete[commercial HVAC, plumbing and electrical contractors integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/commercial-mep-contractors) for the systems and processes around this guide.
